Client Lifecycle States (useAgentRunSocket)

Finite State Machine
01 · CONNECTED
Active

Duplex socket open. Native WebSocket transport active. Client buffer accepting real-time agent envelopes.

readyState: 1
02 · CONNECTING
Transitional

Issuing initial HTTP Upgrade header to ws://... Awaiting 101 Switching Protocols response.

readyState: 0
03 · RECONNECTING
Backoff Active

Network dropped or TCP reset detected. Bounded backoff: min(1000 * 2^attempt, 15000) capped at 5 attempts.

Exponential Backoff
04 · DISCONNECTED
Terminal State

Connection closed cleanly (1000), abnormally (1006), or manually unmounted. Retries exhausted or unmounted.

readyState: 3CURRENT

Architectural Pipeline & Consumer Contract

Pure Consumer Model: This hook strictly ingests runtime broadcast frames from FastAPI (/ws/runs/:run_id). Zero changes to backend runtime (Tamanna) or LangGraph orchestrator (Sanjeevni). No HTTP polling fallback.

SOURCE01
FastAPI WS (Tamanna)

Broadcasts raw runtime frames on /ws/runs/:run_id

useAgentRunSocket Task 3 (This View)

FSM connection lifecycle & safe JSON parser

STATE LAYER03
React Memory Buffer

FIFO bounded queue (default cap: 500 events)

TARGET UI04

Ingests stream directly for real-time inspection
